title: Order book frame
description: The `data` of a `book` topic message on the panel socket: a full snapshot of the aggregated book for one venue, instrument and aggregation rung. Prices and sizes are decimal strings. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (BookFrame). See decision 0007 §2.4.

instrument.description: The venue's instrument id, e.g. BTC or xyz:SPCX.

agg.description: The venue-native aggregation rung this frame was subscribed with (attributed by connection, never by spacing).

nSigFigs.description: Significant figures; null is the finest book.

venueTime.description: The venue's timestamp of the snapshot, milliseconds since the epoch.

coverage.description: Additive (0037 B4): the outer prices of the REST snapshot's proven range. Diffs beyond these edges do not extend that range; coarse buckets crossing an edge are omitted. Absent: no declared snapshot edge.

spread.description: The venue's own spread, sent with aggregated books.

fast.description: The fast book: 5 levels about every 0.5 s (default: 20 levels about every 5 s).

decimal.description: A plain non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number.

prefixItems.description: Number of orders at the level.
